verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec defines a skill as a SKILL.md file of YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, optionally bundled with scripts, references and templates. The skills CLI installs these as plain directories under ./<agent>/skills/ that are committed with the project, and installs from git repos, URLs, direct SKILL.md links or local paths across 70+ agents, with cross-product reuse as an explicit goal. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the on-disk files being manually copied into another harness, and independent corroboration of the plain-file format beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.
Cross-product reuse: Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent.
`./<agent>/skills/` | Committed with your project, shared with team
